a: Yazaalibwa nga 5 Febwali 1837 ku ttaka ettono e Northfield, Massachusetts, nga ye w'omukaaga mu baana omwenda. Bwe yali aweza emyaka ena kitaawe n'afa amangwago, ng'aleka amaka mu bbanja lingi nnyo ne kiba nti ababanja baatwala n'enku ez'okukuma omuliro okuva mu kasenge k'enku; nnyina, Betsey, yagaana okumenyaamenya amaka, era abaana ne bakulira mu bwavu, nga bakozi ba mirimu egy'amaanyi, era nga baasoma katono. Dwight ayinza okuba nga yafuna emyaka etaano gyokka egy'okusoma okwentongole, era ebbaluwa ze zaalina enkovu z'ekyo obulamu bwe bwonna — teyayiga kuwandiika bigambo n'obwesige, era teyalondebwa kuba muweereza wa Katonda.

Bwe yali aweza emyaka kkumi na musanvu yava ku ttaka okugenda e Boston, n'ayingira mu dduuka ly'engatto erya kojjaawe Samuel ng'akozesa ebigambo bye, ku ndagaano nti ajjanga mu kkanisa ne mu ssomero lya Ssande buli wiiki. Omusomesa we ow'essomero lya Ssande, omusajja omukkakkamu ayitibwa Edward Kimball, yamalirira okwogera na buli omu ku balenzi be ku bwabwe ku bikwata ku Kristo. Nga 21 Apuli 1855 Kimball yayingira mu dduuka ly'engatto, n'asanga Moody emabega ng'azinga engatto, n'ateeka omukono ku kibegabega kye, n'amutegeeza mu bwangu okwagala kwa Kristo gy'ali — era awo, wakati mu masenge, Moody n'awa Omulokozi omutima gwe.

q: Lwaki yasooka kugaanibwa kuba wa kibiina ky'ekkanisa?
a: Oluvannyuma Kimball yakkiriza nti mu butono yali alabye omuntu ng'amagezi ge gali mu kizikiza mu by'omwoyo okusinga omukyufu ono omupya, era abakebera b'ekkanisa ne bagaana Moody mu kusaba kwe okusooka okuba ow'ekibiina kubanga yamanya enjigiriza entono nnyo. Naye eggulu, obulamu bwe nga bwe bwandiraze, lyamupima mu ngeri endala: omupakasi ow'omu dduuka ly'engatto eyasoma katono, eyali tasobola kuyita kibuuzo ku njigiriza, mu myaka amakumi abiri yandibadde omubuulizi asinga okumanyibwa ku balamu, ng'abuulidde, okusinziira ku kubalirira okuteefu, abantu abawera obukadde kikumi, awatali leediyo, awatali terevizoni, era awatali na kaayogera n'akamu.

q: Omulimu gwe ogw'olubereberye e Chicago gwali gutya?
a: Bwe yasengukira e Chicago mu 1856, yatunda engatto n'obunyiikivu bwe yakolanga buli kimu, n'apangisa entebe mu kkanisa n'azijjuza abavubuka be yakuŋŋaanya okuva mu nguudo. Mu 1858 yatandika essomero lya Ssande mu kitundu ky'obwavu ekyali eky'amaanyi ennyo ne kiyitibwa "Little Hell" (Ggeyeena Entono), ng'asikiriza abayizi n'obuwoomerevu, entambula ku mbalaasi ento n'obugumiikiriza obutakoowa, okutuusa abaana lukumi mu bikumi bitaano lwe baali bajja; mu 1860 pulezidenti omulonde, Abraham Lincoln, yakyalira essomero. Mu mwaka ogwo Moody yaleka omulimu gw'obusuubuzi ogwali gukulaakulana, n'okuyaayaanira kwe okuweza obugagga bwa doola emitwalo kkumi, okuwa Katonda obudde bwe bwonna — mikwano gye ne balowooza nti yagudde eddalu ne bamuyita "Moody Omulalu."

q: Kiki ekyaliwo ku kiro ky'Omuliro Omunene ogwa Chicago?
a: Nga 8 Okitobba 1871, ng'abuulira ekibiina ekisinga obunene kye yali abadde afunye e Chicago, yasembayo n'asaba ekibiina okugenda ewaka ne balowooza kye bandikoze ne Yesu, era baddeyo wiiki eddako n'eky'okuddamu kyabwe. Ekiro ekyo Omuliro Omunene gwazikiriza ekizimbe ekyo, ekkanisa ye, ennyumba ye n'ekitundu ekinene ky'ekibuga, era abamu ku baali bawuliriza tebaddayo kulabika. Teyakyerabira: okutuusa ku nkomerero y'obulamu bwe yagaana okuleka abawuliriza okugenda awatali kubawaliriza okusalirawo Kristo mu kiro ekyo kyennyini, mu kifo ky'okwesiga wiiki eddako eyinza obutatuuka.

q: Amaanyi ge yafuna mu 1871 gaali gatya?
a: Abakazi babiri abaasaba, Sarah Cooke ne Mukyala Hawxhurst, baali batandise okutuula ku ntebe ey'omu maaso mu nkuŋŋaana ze, nga bamutegeeza mu lwatu nti baali bamusabira afune amaanyi g'Omwoyo. Okusooka ekyo kyamunyiiza — yalowooza nti yalina amaanyi agamala — naye amangu yali yeegayirira Katonda awamu nabo. Wiiki nga ziyiseewo okuva ku muliro, ng'atambula mu luguudo mu New York, eky'okuddamu ne kijja: okubeerawo kwa Katonda kwamujjira mu ngeri ey'amaanyi ennyo ne yanguwa okutuuka mu nnyumba ya munne abeere yekka, era n'asaba Katonda okuziyiza omukono gwe. Okubuulira, yagamba, kwali kwe kumu — naye kaakano ebikumi baakyuka gye baali edda abantu batono buto baakyukira.

Yali awulidde omubuulizi Henry Varley ng'agamba nti: "Ensi ekyalina okulaba Katonda ky'alikola ne, era ku lwa, era okuyita mu, era munda mu, era ku, omuntu eyeewaayo gy'ali mu bujjuvu era n'omutima gwe gwonna." Moody n'amalirira okukiddamu: "Olw'ekisa kya Katonda, nnaaba omuntu oyo." Okuva ku muvubuka omubuulizi Omungereza Harry Moorhouse — eyabuulira ekiro musanvu kiddiriranganako ku Yokaana 3:16 — era yali ayize okubuulira Katonda ayagala aboonoonyi mu kifo ky'oyo abakuŋŋunta bukuŋŋunta, era eddoboozi eryo ery'okwagala kwa Katonda ne lifuuka omutima gw'obubaka bwe.

q: Kaweefube we mu Bungereza yagenda atya?
a: Mu Juuni 1873 yasaabala mu meeri okugenda mu Bungereza n'omuyimbi Ira Sankey nga kumpi tewali biyita by'omugaso. Ebyaddirira byewuunyisa buli omu okuggyako Katonda: okuva e York ne Newcastle enkuŋŋaana zaasaasaana okutuuka e Edinburgh, abasomi b'eby'eddiini ab'ekibuga abaali baamanyiddwa olw'obwegendereza bwabwe gye baasikirizibwa, oluvannyuma Glasgow, Belfast ne Dublin, oluvannyuma emyezi ena mu London mu 1875, abantu abaajjanga gye baabalirwa mu bukadde. Amawulire g'e Bungereza tegaasobola kunnyonnyola engeri Omunnamerika atali muyivu, ng'abuulira emboozi entereevu mu ddoboozi ery'Ekyamerika ery'amangu nga Sankey ayimba ng'akozesa akalagi akatono, gye yali ajjuza ebisenge ebisinga obunene mu bwakabaka.

Omusajja ow'emyaka etaano egy'okusoma yatandikawo Northfield Seminary ey'abawala mu 1879 ne Mount Hermon School ey'abalenzi mu 1881, ng'azijjuza abayizi abaali abaavu ennyo okuyingira awalala. Enkuŋŋaana ze ez'omu biseera by'ekyeya e Northfield zaakoleeza Student Volunteer Movement (Ekibiina ky'Abayizi Abeewaayo), ekyatuma enkumi z'abaminsani abavubuka okwetooloola ensi yonna. Mu 1886 yatandikawo Moody Bible Institute e Chicago okusomesa "abasajja b'ekituli," era mu 1894, ng'akakasizza nti ebitabo ebirungi tebisaanira kuba bugagga bwa kwenoomanoona, yatandikawo ekibiina ky'okusaasaanya ebitabo ekyakuba ebitabo eby'Ekikristaayo ebinywevu eby'omuwendo omutono ogwenkanankana empeera y'omupakasi.

Mu Novemba 1899, wakati mu kaweefube e Kansas City, omutima gwe omunene gwatandika okulemererwa, era n'aleetebwa ewaka e Northfield, mu kisenge gye yazaalirwa emyaka nkaaga mu ebiri emabega. Ku makya g'omu 22 Desemba 1899 yawulirwa ng'agamba mu bujjuvu nti: "Ensi edda emabega; eggulu liggukira mu maaso gange ... Buno bwe buwanguzi bwange; luno lwe lunaku lwange olw'okwambazibwa engule!" Emyezi nga giyiseeko yali ategeezezza abawuliriza nti: "Olunaku olumu ojja kusoma mu mpapula z'amawulire nti D. L. Moody ... afudde. Tokkiriza kigambo na kimu ku ekyo! Mu kaseera ako nnaaba mulamu okusinga bwe ndi kaakati."
